title: Peri-peri chicken with roast butternut and broccoli
summary: Big on flavour, low on carbs.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Peel the butternut and cut it into cubes about 2 cm across, and cut the pepper into strips.
Rub the chicken with peri-peri, salt and half the oil, and toss the butternut and pepper with the rest of the oil.
Put everything on a baking tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets, turn them in the pan juices and roast for 10 minutes more.
Check the chicken is cooked: no pink in the thickest part and clear juices. Rest it for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with the vegetables.
